incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'west-eu-gpus' reporting low effective capacity. queue_depth=11,200; avg_latency p95=980ms; autoscaler failing to add nodes (errors in controller logs). multiple nodes showing CUDA/Xid and driver OOMs. paging oncall.

Maya (oncall): I'm on it. seeing large backlog on the inference queue dashboard. any immediate customer-facing impact? @Jin (CS) can you start triage on potential customer pages? :eyes:

Jin (CS): flagging top affected customers (two enterprise tenants) and drafting a short note. will update with severity and ETA. currently no outage reported by customers but latency spikes causing degraded UX for some tenants.

Sanjay: looking at autoscaler logs: `scaleup rejected: rate_limit_per_min exceeded` and `error: incompatible instance type requested`. autoscaler attempted to request 6 nodes but cloud returned 400 for two requests. also seeing repeated Xid 13 from nodes gpu-node-23, gpu-node-27, gpu-node-31.

Alice: from node logs (snippet):
```
[2026-03-15T09:11:02Z] driver: cuda: Xid 13 at 0x7ff... GPU0
[2026-03-15T09:11:02Z] oom-killer: process inference-runner killed by OOM
[2026-03-15T09:11:04Z] kubelet: node lost ready status
```
Nodes are flapping Ready=false briefly then back. this reduces effective capacity and confuses the autoscaler.

infra-eng: confirmed cloud-side limits are hit for the account in west-eu (soft quota). I'm requesting quota increase but that's slow. For immediate mitigation we can: 1) throttle non-critical tenant routes, 2) shift burst traffic to east-us-warm pool, or 3) spin up smaller instance types (T4-equivalent) as fallback.

eng-runtime: runtime stacks on flapping nodes show a recent driver package that may correlate. There's a staged driver roll last night (package v522.15 -> v522.18) on ~60% of the fleet. node-23/27/31 have v522.18. suspect regression causing intermittent Xid and memory leak under high batch sizes.

Maya (oncall): ops-sre, can we cordon + drain the three suspicious nodes to stop flapping and return them to image build? I'll add node selectors to avoid scheduling until we confirm driver rollback.

ops-sre: cordon+drain started for gpu-node-23, gpu-node-27, gpu-node-31. using `kubectl cordon` then `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. moving low-priority pods first. ETA ~6m to drain and reschedule workloads.

Sanjay: while draining, autoscaler is still failing scaleups due to the cloud quota + API error 429 bursts. I've temporarily increased the scale_limit_per_min to allow a larger burst (manual override) and requested a quota emergency via cloud console.

eng-runtime: pushing a canary rollback of driver to v522.15 on two test nodes to validate. if stable for 10m under similar workload we'll proceed fleet-wide. rolling patch job queued via deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: started job `driver-rollback-canary` against nodes [gpu-node-45,gpu-node-46]. logs: `canary: success - 8/10 inference runs ok, no Xid in 10m window`.

Alice: queue depth trending down after throttling non-critical routes and draining flappers. queue=6,400 now. p95 latency 420ms. still some throttling events for low-tier customers — notify CS.

Jin (CS): sending customer note: "We're experiencing elevated inference latencies in west-eu; mitigation in progress — some non-critical jobs are queued/limited. We'll provide ETA after autoscaler stabilizes."

Maya (oncall): next steps: 1) proceed with fleet rollback to v522.15 if canary remains stable (eng-runtime to confirm), 2) keep cordon on flappers until reimage, 3) maintain throttles and routing to east-us as fallback, 4) open P0 postmortem and include quota and driver rollout as contributing factors. tagging @eng-runtime for timeline.

eng-runtime: canary stable at +18m. initiating rollback rollout with canary percent 10 -> 50 -> 100, monitoring Xid logs and OOMs. rolling out over 20m.

ops-sre: rollback rollout in progress, rebalancing pods as nodes are updated. autoscaler now sees more steady Ready capacity, but cloud quota still at soft cap; cloud team approved emergency quota bump (temporary). autoscaler accepted scale requests again.

Sanjay: autoscaler resumed successful adds; observed 8 nodes added over 12m. current effective GPU count +24. queue trending to 900. p95 latency 180ms.

Maya (oncall): status: mitigations applied, queue draining, driver rollback in progress, cloud quota bumped temporarily. I'll keep this thread open for final resolution and postmortem assignment. If anything changes ping me. :white_check_mark:

Alice: creating incident ticket and assigning P0 postmortem to eng-runtime + infra. early blameless notes: driver regression + quota exhaustion + autoscaler limits combined to cause capacity collapse.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Incident active -> mitigated. Start time 4387654321. Mitigation applied 4387654378. Assigned: eng-runtime, infra-eng, ops-sre. Please file postmortem within 72h. :memo:
